response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS avg_orders FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.order_count, c.order_count - a.avg_orders AS diff_from_avg FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_orders), avg_above AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS avg_above_orders FROM above) SELECT ab.account_id, ab.order_count, ab.diff_from_avg AS above_overall_average, ab.order_count - aa.avg_above_orders AS above_average_of_above FROM above ab CROSS JOIN avg_above aa ORDER BY above_average_of_above DESC LIMIT 10
